name: Enterprise External Norm and Applicability Assessment
constraints: WM-POL-001 is the sole master of legal work, expression, manifestation, source, provision and normalized norm identity.
ExternalRequirement profiles exactly one externally originated WM-POL-001 norm identity and binds at least one provision of exactly one expression without minting work identity.
NormVersion profiles one WM-POL-001 expression only; it is not a temporal slice, market reading or knowledge-time snapshot.

Publication or promulgation, provision-scoped commencement, efficacy or applicability, transitional or compliance deadline, repeal or supersession, knowledge time, assessment facts-as-of and assessment performed-at are pairwise distinct axes.
NormVersion never implies uniform commencement; commencement and repeal records bind individual provisions and conditional events.
Source exception, authority-backed derogation, beneficiary-scoped exemption and transitional period are distinct typed records; boolean exemption flags and free-text applicability basis are invalid.
A derogation cites enabling authority; an exemption names beneficiary, scope, authority and interval; a non-derogable floor survives both.
WM-ACT-034 owns ApplicabilityAssessment identity, lifecycle, assessor, performed-at, review or expiry and explicit supersession.

Every issued assessment immutably pins expression, provisions, subject, activity, product and market state, external jurisdiction key-as-of, facts-as-of, reasoning, evidence, conclusion, confidence and limitations.

Concurrent issued assessments coexist; silent merge, overwrite, latest-wins and implicit supersession are forbidden; replacement requires explicit named supersession within the same accountable series and equivalent pin set.
Jurisdiction is an external time-qualified reference with stable key-as-of contract and competence hierarchy; EM-LEG-02 allocates no jurisdiction identifier.
WM-KNW-012 may provide attributable interpretation evidence but never owns or concludes applicability and never replaces source text.
Citation, applicability, obligation and compliance are four separate claims: applicability never creates WM-XCT-029 duty identity and compliance is never stored on the assessment.
WM-XCT-029 alone owns instantiated duties; uncommenced provisions generate no new duties and repeal never deletes historical duty or assessment evidence.
Indeterminate and disputed are first-class assessment conclusions and different market pins create peer assessments rather than legal-version forks.
holds: WM-POL-001 must expose the eight distinct temporal axes and provision-level commencement in its canonical profile.
WM-ACT-034 must support structured immutable pins and concurrent issued peers.
External jurisdiction key-as-of binding and specialist legal review remain required before canonical publication.
The profile is provider-reconciled and single-audited but remains noncanonical and noninstallable.
